ops.title: REST plane nil-DB panic: browser "Failed to fetch" (fixed in v0.21.3)
ops.body:
Root cause of every-`/api/*`-request panicking (browser "Failed to fetch"): `daemon.Serve` mounted the REST plane with `Store: store.New(s.DB())` before `s.Serve(ctx)`, but cc-interact v0.15.0 opens the daemon store only inside Serve (daemonkit `Activate` → `bootReconcile` → `startHTTP`), so `s.DB()` was nil at mount time — frozen into the REST `store`/`subjects`/`turns` fields. Handlers panicked in database/sql; net/http dropped the connection with no response. The IPC plane resolves `hc.DB` per request, which is why only the browser broke. No browser-origin event ever succeeded after the cc-interact v1 runtime adoption.

Fix (v0.21.3, commit 17f874b): `httpapi.Deps` carries `DB func() *sql.DB` (wired `DB: s.DB`), resolved per request via `Server.st()/subjectStore()/turnStore()` — all stateless one-field wraps. Regression test `internal/daemon/serve_test.go` boots the real `Serve` and asserts `/api/session/nope` → 404.

cc-interact API footgun to fix upstream: `daemon.New`'s doc invites mounting routes on `Mux()` before `Serve`, while `Server.DB()` silently returns nil until activation — an eager capture compiles fine and fails only at request time. cc-interact should either panic in `DB()` pre-activation or expose a lazy accessor shape. cc-review's other four `store.New(s.DB())` sites (onPresenceChange, bootReconcile, sweepLoop) are safe — they resolve at call time, post-activation.
